info.title: Wethaq API
info.description: Application service for Wethaq (GP482): Express + PostgreSQL, with shipment rules enforced by the Hyperledger Fabric chaincode (or, in development, by the local development ledger, which is not Fabric). All routes are under /api.

txId.description: 64-hex ledger transaction id (absent for application-level rejections)

checkpointReset.description: Set when the checkpoint was found ahead of the ledger at startup

202.description: Case C (unknown): submitted, the ledger has not confirmed it yet; applied automatically later

409.description: Conflict: invalidated by the peers (for example MVCC), or the shipment's registration is still pending

502.description: Case C (definite): the peers did not endorse it; nothing was recorded

503.description: Case C (definite): the ledger is not reachable; nothing was recorded

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
